content.text: Minimal is unclearly defined, is it just no containment and membership triples?
Either way we have a different response depending on if you ask for:
One returns server managed triples (include=...) the other does not (return=minimal).
Seeing what F5 does should shine some light on the goal. In any case, I believe this should be the Beta/6.0.0 release.
To confirm (as my last request in the last comment was incorrect) the result is correct.
Which means there is a difference in Fedora 5 between return=minimal and return=representation; include="
Describes how Fedora considers both "PreferMinimalContainer", and "return=minimal"
Fedora needs to handle a request for a minimal container, this is defined by the LDP spec as

> The portion of an LDPC's triples that would be present when the container is empty. Currently, this definition is equivalent to all the LDPC's triples minus its containment triples, and minus its membership triples (if either are considered part of its state), but if future versions of LDP define additional classes of triples then this definition would expand to subtract out those classes as well.
Based on this definition, this ticket will rely on the ability to produce containment and membership triples.

comments.body:
Minimal is unclearly defined, is it just no containment and membership triples?

Either way we have a different response depending on if you ask for:

Prefer: return=minimal

or

Prefer: include="http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#PreferMinimalContainer"

One returns server managed triples (include=...) the other does not (return=minimal).

Should these be the same?
Seeing what F5 does should shine some light on the goal. In any case, I believe this should be the Beta/6.0.0 release.

5.1.1

> curl -ufedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin http://localhost:8080/rest/test
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix fedora: <http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/repository#> .
@prefix ldp: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#> .
@prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .

<http://localhost:8080/rest/test>
rdf:type fedora:Container ;
rdf:type fedora:Resource ;
rdf:type ldp:BasicContainer ;
dc:title "My object" ;
fedora:lastModifiedBy "fedoraAdmin" ;
fedora:createdBy "fedoraAdmin" ;
fedora:created "2020-11-26T15:51:26.71Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime> ;
fedora:lastModified "2020-11-26T15:51:26.71Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime> ;
dc:description " A test object" ;
rdf:type ldp:RDFSource ;
rdf:type ldp:Container .

 

> curl -ufedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin http://localhost:8080/rest/test -H"Prefer: return=minimal"
@prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .

<http://localhost:8080/rest/test>
dc:title "My object" ;
dc:description " A test object" .

 

> curl -ufedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin http://localhost:8080/rest/test -H"Prefer: include=\"http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#PreferMinimalContainer\""
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix fedora: <http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/repository#> .
@prefix ldp: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#> .
@prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .

<http://localhost:8080/rest/test>
rdf:type fedora:Container ;
rdf:type fedora:Resource ;
rdf:type ldp:BasicContainer ;
dc:title "My object" ;
fedora:lastModifiedBy "fedoraAdmin" ;
fedora:createdBy "fedoraAdmin" ;
fedora:created "2020-11-26T15:51:26.71Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime> ;
fedora:lastModified "2020-11-26T15:51:26.71Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime> ;
dc:description " A test object" ;
rdf:type ldp:RDFSource ;
rdf:type ldp:Container .

To confirm (as my last request in the last comment was incorrect) the result is correct.

 

> curl -ufedoraAdmin:fedoraAdmin http://localhost:8080/rest/test -H"Prefer: return=representation; include=\"http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#PreferMinimalContainer\""
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix fedora: <http://fedora.info/definitions/v4/repository#> .
@prefix ldp: <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#> .
@prefix dc: <http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/> .

<http://localhost:8080/rest/test>
rdf:type fedora:Container ;
rdf:type fedora:Resource ;
rdf:type ldp:BasicContainer ;
dc:title "My object" ;
fedora:lastModifiedBy "fedoraAdmin" ;
fedora:createdBy "fedoraAdmin" ;
fedora:created "2020-11-26T15:51:26.71Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime> ;
fedora:lastModified "2020-11-26T15:54:12.732Z"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime> ;
dc:description " A test object" ;
rdf:type ldp:RDFSource ;
rdf:type ldp:Container .

 

Which means there is a difference in Fedora 5 between return=minimal and return=representation; include="http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#PreferMinimalContainer".

References:

  1. https://www.w3.org/TR/ldp/
    • Describes how LDP considers "PreferMinimalContainer"
  2. https://wiki.lyrasis.org/display/FEDORA6x/RESTful+HTTP+API+-+Containers
    • Describes how Fedora considers both "PreferMinimalContainer", and "return=minimal"
  3. https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc8144
    • Describes "Prefer" header

So much cleaner. Very nice.
One minor suggestion.
